_about: The sample game's animation test sheets (job fw-F7): a hosting game's animation_reviews.json merges these categories into its own (make_animation_category_review.catalog), with assetRoot read inside this game's folder.

cincinnatus.title: Cincinnatus slice (second game)
cincinnatus.note: Job fw-F6 painterly gouache. All 63 walk drawings and 12 battle poses are reviewable below at game atlas size with normal/slow playback, pause, stepping and scrubbing. Walk order is stand, stride A, stand, stride B. Known defects: several stride pairs repeat limb phases; Racilia's shawl and the young envoy's toga swap sides in a stride; side views are lower-angle than the scene. Down battle poses collapse to a knee, not fully prone. Originals are unchanged; see games/cincinnatus/art-handoff-phase2.md. The engine links show staging and actual battle usage.
